headlines.title: Arsenal Double winner Storey dies aged 81
headlines.description: Former Arsenal and England midfielder Peter Storey - who helped the Gunners win the Double in 1970-71 - has died at the age of 81.

headlines.title: Madrid-bound Gabriel posts farewell Man Utd message
headlines.description: TeenagerJJ Gabriel posts a farewell message saying Manchester United will always be part of his story, as he prepares for a likely move to Real Madrid.

headlines.title: Liverpool lead Chelsea in Camara race - Wednesday's gossip
headlines.description: Liverpool leading Chelsea in race for Monaco's Lamine Camara, Barcelona rule out moves for Virgil van Dijk and Bruno Fernandes, and ex-Crystal Palace winger Wilfried Zaha could rejoin the club.
